objective: Make the creative graph, rather than the prompt, the canonical unit of work for promptless SOVARA Creative workflows.
anti_sprawl: Do not create a new top-level creative subsystem where SC-GRAPH or an existing specialist domain can absorb the capability cleanly.
truth_boundary: Source and CI admission prove only the deterministic in-process graph contract and its binding to SC-VERSION-TREE. They do not prove durable graph storage, provider execution, media generation, saved Canva design, production deployment, commercial value, repeated success, soak, or estate-wide maturity.
